gold: Tufted angioma with somatic KDR mutation

selector.rationale: Angiosarcoma best explains the decisive findings of a single, well-defined, blanchable bright red plaque densely composed of telangiectasias and the presence of a somatic mutation in KDR (VEGFR2)

rejected.label: Telangiectasia
rejected.why: presence of a somatic mutation in KDR (VEGFR2)

support_spans: a single, well-defined, blanchable bright red plaque densely composed of telangiectasias on his lower right lateral shin
